name: qa-engineering
description: The single AI QA engineering plugin: one orchestrator for the whole loop — analyze an ADO story, author and approve test cases, publish them to a Test Plan/Suite, build and generate API + UI automation, and turn a failing run into a filed bug, human-gated at every tracker write. Also teaches and reviews a Playwright + TypeScript framework. Self-contained with its own native QA skills; ships no product data — the QA supplies tracker, API, auth and URLs locally through a git-ignored house-profile and .env.
